posts.text: Any fans of classic #DoctorWho out here? The Doctor Who Appreciation Society has just released a new hardcover on the #ThirdDoctor and #FourthDoctor eras, and I've got a feature in it! Hit the link in my bio to find out more and get your own copy.

Check out my new book review to stay on #falltok🍁 ! LITTLE MONSTERS, a modern paranormal retelling of #LittleWomen, is out now from @simonbooks . Hit the link in my bio to read my full review and to find some cozy bookish goods! ☕: @drinkchapters 🕯️: @frostbeardstudio #booktok #bookreview #linkinbio #fyp #littlemonsters #reading #tbr

MY KILLER FAMILY REUNION is now available from @Simon Books ! Check out my full review of this new mystery read at the link in my bio.  #booktok #bookreview  ☕️: @Chapters Tea & Company  🕯️: @Frostbeard Studio

#SurvivalShow by @Juno is out now! The Hunger Games meets The Spice Girls in this new dystopian YA novel. What did I think? Hit the link in my bio for my full review! 🕯️ by @Frostbeard Studio  ✨ by @Velvet Hammer  #booktok #bookreview
KILLING SADIE is available now from @Simon Books and it’s quickly become my favorite book of the summer. Hit the link in my bio to check out my thoughts! #booktok #bookreview

New tomorrow from @Simon Books ! Check out my review of The Season of Light and Darkness at the link in my bio. Plus get codes for @Chapters Tea & Company and @Frostbeard Studio for bookish tea and scented candles! #booktok #bookreview #tea #cozy #linkinbio
